protocol.scope: all ten historical development tasks are feedback and evaluation each round
protocol.parent_policy: native-retained harness and its own complete trajectories; independent framework lineages
protocol.native_state: one native step per outer round seeded with current parent; prior public attempt summaries carried; native internal long-run scheduler/archive is locally reinitialized
protocol.empty_round_policy: delivery_failed, do not claim unchanged H0 is a successful modification
protocol.raw_and_retained: report raw tested version separately from native-retained version; carry retention, not rejected candidates
protocol.infrastructure_policy: no automatic paid worker retries; block broken lineage, preserve all partial evidence
protocol.harnessfix_feedback: train and selection callbacks both use same TEN tasks, evaluation cache avoids double paid runs
protocol.dgm_bugfix: predeclared unresolved-or-empty-patch selection fallback, same seed17; unchanged upstream on disk
protocol.native_role_turn_limits: unchanged native one-step limits within shared per-round ledger
protocol.baseline: reuse one source-locked ten-task H0 from unified-hard10-v1, 3/10; no old candidate reused
protocol.scope_reduction: fresh high-budget rerun; old lower-budget results retained separately
protocol.global_cap: 100 target worker executions includes all legacy started retests; require 10 free slots for a new complete candidate evaluation
protocol.model_validity_repair: up to three sessions inside same400/8M ledger, only before task evaluation; no human edits
protocol.native_completion: at most two native checkpoint attempts, no paid task retries and one evaluated final candidate
protocol.protocol_scope: high budget plus stage allocation and explicit model validity repair; not a pure budget-only ablation
